name: Multiphase flow metering
principle: Meters measure oil, water and gas rates without separation. Emerson's Roxar 2600 combines a Venturi differential-pressure measurement with electrical impedance and optional gamma densitometry, reports at 10 Hz and covers 0 to 100% water-liquid ratio and 0 to 100% gas volume fraction.

process_steps.name: Impedance and gamma give phase fractions
